basis: Domain first; dominant memory interface second. Orthogonal mechanism tags and six evidence axes. A dated snapshot is used in the companion manuscript.

groups.description_en: Video and latent world models, persistent world state, and world-action models. Video generation is a relevant precursor, not automatically a robot policy.
groups.description_zh: 视频与潜在世界模型、持续世界状态、世界动作模型。视频生成是相关前驱，不自动等同于机器人策略。

groups.tagline_zh: 用必要的历史作出动作。
groups.description_en: History-conditioned action policies: visual-language-action models and memory-relevant visuomotor precursors. Action chunks alone do not establish memory.
groups.description_zh: 以历史为条件的动作策略：VLA 及相关视觉运动方法。输出动作 chunk 本身不构成记忆证据。

groups.description_en: Embodied agents that retain task, spatial, episodic, or procedural state; VLM planners, VLA/WAM executors, and runtime harnesses. Navigation and mapping precursors are labeled by scope.
groups.description_zh: 保留任务、空间、情景或程序状态的具身智能体；涵盖 VLM 规划、VLA/WAM 执行与 harness。导航及建图前驱另行标明证据范围。

groups.tagline_zh: 理解可迁移的基础机制。
groups.description_en: General memory architectures, language-agent systems, selected model/control baselines, evaluation tools and surveys. Supporting references are not additional embodied-memory methods.
groups.description_zh: 通用记忆架构、语言智能体系统、选定模型与控制基线、评测工具及综述；支撑文献不等同于新增具身记忆方法。

categories.definition: Observed history, anchor frames, rolling windows, and cache policies.
categories.description_en: Observed history at one or more temporal scales, initial anchors, rolling windows, and cache retention policies.
categories.description_zh: 单尺度或多尺度真实观察历史、首帧锚点、滚动窗口与缓存保留策略。

categories.definition: Compact historical states, latent recurrence, and state-space dynamics.
categories.description_en: Compact historical states, latent recurrence, and state-space dynamics.
categories.description_zh: 紧凑历史状态、潜变量递归与状态空间动力学。

categories.definition: Addressable evidence through retrieval, geometry, maps, and view consistency.
categories.description_en: Addressable evidence through retrieval, geometry, maps, and view consistency.
categories.description_zh: 通过检索、几何、地图及视角一致性寻址历史证据。

categories.definition: Entity persistence, object permanence, state revision, and shared worlds.
categories.description_en: Entity persistence, object permanence, state revision, and shared worlds.
categories.description_zh: 实体持续性、物体恒存、状态修订与共享世界。

categories.definition: World prediction linked to planning and control; predictions are distinguished from observed memory.
categories.description_en: World prediction linked to planning and control; predictions are distinguished from observed memory.
categories.description_zh: 连接世界预测、规划与控制；区分生成的未来和观测到的过去。

categories.description_en: Memory-relevant training, consolidation, adaptation, cache validity and execution timing; labeled contextual when no online memory mechanism is established.
categories.description_zh: 与记忆相关的训练、整合、适配、缓存有效性和执行时序；未建立在线记忆机制时标注为背景。
categories.definition: Memory-relevant training, consolidation, adaptation and runtime boundaries.
Recall, revisits, hidden-state evolution, and world-model evaluation.
categories.description_en: Recall, revisits, hidden-state evolution, and world-model evaluation.
categories.description_zh: 回忆、重访、隐状态演化与世界模型评测。

categories.definition: Observation histories and cache interfaces consumed by action policies.
categories.description_en: Observation histories and cache interfaces consumed by action policies.
categories.description_zh: 动作策略实际消费的观测历史与缓存接口。

categories.definition: Recurrent tokens, belief states, and compressed control history.
categories.description_en: Visual token pooling, learned history compression, recurrent tokens, and compact belief states for action policies.
categories.description_zh: 面向动作策略的视觉 token 池化、学习式历史压缩、循环 token 与紧凑信念状态。

categories.definition: Selective writes and retrieval of past task evidence.
categories.description_en: Retained episodes and keyframes, selective writes, and retrieval of task-relevant past evidence.
categories.description_zh: 保留情景与关键帧，通过选择性写入和检索获取与任务相关的历史证据。

categories.definition: Progress records, language scratchpads, latent plans, and action continuity; intended actions are not executed facts.
categories.description_en: Progress records, language scratchpads, latent plans, and action continuity; intended actions are not executed facts.
categories.description_zh: 进度记录、语言草稿、潜在计划及动作连续性；计划动作并非已执行事实。

categories.definition: Object traces, geometry, executed actions, proprioception, contact and tactile history.
categories.description_en: Object traces, geometry, executed actions, proprioception, contact and tactile history.
categories.description_zh: 对象轨迹、几何、已执行动作、本体状态、接触与触觉历史。

categories.description_en: Memory-relevant training, consolidation, adaptation, cache validity and execution timing; labeled contextual when no online memory mechanism is established.
categories.description_zh: 与记忆相关的训练、整合、适配、缓存有效性和执行时序；未建立在线记忆机制时标注为背景。
categories.definition: Memory-relevant training, consolidation, adaptation and runtime boundaries.
Non-Markovian tasks, interference, control dependence, and policy evaluation context.
categories.description_en: Non-Markovian tasks, interference, control dependence, and policy evaluation context.
categories.description_zh: 非马尔可夫任务、干扰、控制依赖与相关策略评测。

categories.definition: Time-indexed experience that an embodied agent can revisit and use.
categories.description_en: Time-indexed experience that an embodied agent can revisit and use.
categories.description_zh: 具身智能体可重新检索并使用的带时间经历。

categories.definition: Maps, scene graphs, entities, and grounded knowledge across observations.
categories.description_en: Maps, scene graphs, entities, and grounded knowledge across observations.
categories.description_zh: 跨观测保留的地图、场景图、实体与具身知识。

categories.definition: Subgoals, beliefs, progress tracking, and plans grounded in accumulated evidence.
categories.description_en: Persistent subgoals, progress records, semantic updates, and visual cues passed from planners to VLA/WAM executors.
categories.description_zh: 持续子目标、进度记录、语义更新，以及从规划器传递给 VLA/WAM 执行器的视觉线索。

categories.definition: Executable skills, program state, tool runtimes, and state handoff.
categories.description_en: Executable skills, program state, tool runtimes, and state handoff.
categories.description_zh: 可执行技能、程序状态、工具运行时与状态交接。

categories.definition: Failure analysis, experience consolidation, and adaptation across attempts.
categories.description_en: Failure analysis, experience consolidation, and adaptation across attempts.
categories.description_zh: 失败分析、经验整合与跨尝试适配。

categories.definition: Embodied tasks and tests of persistent experience, reasoning, and interaction.
categories.description_en: Embodied tasks and tests of persistent experience, reasoning, and interaction.
categories.description_zh: 具身任务及对持续经历、推理、交互的测试。

categories.definition: Transferable attention, recurrence, state-space, and external-memory architectures.
categories.description_en: Transferable memory architectures and selected model/control baselines used to interpret memory claims.
categories.description_zh: 可迁移记忆架构，以及用于解释记忆主张的选定模型与控制基线。

categories.label_zh: 通用智能体记忆与运行时
categories.definition: Language-agent memory and harness designs without a verified embodied deployment in this record.
categories.description_en: Language-agent memory and harness designs without a verified embodied deployment in this record.
categories.description_zh: 当前条目未核实具身部署的语言智能体记忆与运行框架。

categories.definition: Prior syntheses and conceptual framing.
categories.description_en: Prior syntheses and conceptual framing.
categories.description_zh: 既有综述与概念框架。

categories.definition: Supporting memory benchmarks and datasets outside direct robot-memory evaluation.
categories.description_en: Supporting memory benchmarks and datasets outside direct robot-memory evaluation.
categories.description_zh: 直接机器人记忆评测以外的支撑性基准与数据。

mechanism_tags.definition: Carries an unexecuted proposed action tail or other replanning state. It must not be labeled executed action history without an execution receipt.
Explicit program variables, control phase, predicates or continuation state carried across controller calls; distinct from a frozen reusable skill library.

mechanism_tags.label_zh: 自适应记忆预算与路由
规划器与策略的记忆交接

six_axes.description_zh: 真实观察、执行回执、示教、生成假设、反思或权重；不能把预测当作事实。
six_axes.description_en: Observed evidence, execution receipts, demonstrations, generated hypotheses, reflections, or weights; forecasts are not observations.

six_axes.description_zh: 帧或 latent、KV、递归状态、对象槽、轨迹、地图、文本、图或技能参数。
six_axes.description_en: Frames/latents, KV states, recurrent states, slots, trajectories, maps, text, graphs, or skill parameters.

six_axes.description_zh: 按物理时间、空间、实体、事件、任务阶段、动作效果或语义查询定位内容。
six_axes.description_en: Address by physical time, space, entity, event, task stage, action effect, or semantic query.

six_axes.description_zh: 写入、读取、压缩、合并、更新、遗忘、失效、验证与重算。
six_axes.description_en: Write, read, compress, merge, update, forget, invalidate, verify, and recompute.

six_axes.description_zh: 一次查询、chunk、episode、跨 episode 或持续部署；同时报告事件时间和证据有效性。
six_axes.description_en: Within-query, chunk, episode, cross-episode, or deployment persistence; retain event time and validity.

six_axes.description_zh: 视频预测器、动作专家、高层规划器、验证器或 harness；保存的信息必须到达合适的读者。
six_axes.description_en: Video predictor, action expert, high-level planner, verifier, or harness; useful state must reach the correct reader.

counting_rules: One primary domain and method family per research-work ID; secondary tags never multiply counts.
Domain assignment describes the main consumer/interface, not a claim that domains are mutually exclusive.
Preserve evidence role and review depth. Supporting foundations and contextual baselines are visibly distinguished.
Research papers/reports, implementation observations, and industry essays are separate collections.
No full-paper review or reproduced performance is inferred from abstract screening.
